name: ca77y-library
description: Research-library crew as Claude Code subagents, maintaining a project's Markdown research library in place: researcher (deep-dive orchestrator that searches the library first, runs a web dive following every lead, persists raw sources, and produces a synthesized wiki entry), librarian (cited answers from the wiki, verified against raw notes), scribe (ingests raw notes into the wiki, updating synthesis, links, taxonomy, index, and the maintenance log), and clerk (audits library health — duplicates, stale index entries, broken links, uncited claims, missing tags, leaked meta-instructions). Also carries the bootstrap skill (`/ca77y-library:bootstrap`), which scaffolds the fixed `library/` folder — README, CLAUDE.md, _meta/ (index, taxonomy, log, librarian conventions, templates), raw/, wiki/ — that every agent above reads and writes directly, in a project that doesn't have one yet. Self-contained: it needs no other plugin, and pairs with ca77y-engineering when that pipeline is also installed.
